scenarios.name: Bear
scenarios.description: Google referral collapse + AI-search displacement + ad-price war: Y1 growth 10%, margins 22.5%->28%, WACC 13.5%, TG 2.5%.

scenarios.name: Conservative
scenarios.description: Deceleration to low-teens growth and margin-grind stall: Y1 growth 24%, margins 26.5%->32%, WACC 12.5%.

scenarios.name: Base
scenarios.description: Consensus-like growth (35% decaying 5pts/yr to 15%), smooth 1pt/yr margin ramp to 32.5% (34% terminal), WACC 12.0%.

scenarios.name: Optimistic
scenarios.description: Google search normalizes, ads + data licensing compound: Y1 growth 45%, margins 30.5%->36%, WACC 11.5%.

scenarios.name: Bull
scenarios.description: Google deal renewed, AI licensing scales, Meta-like ARPU: Y1 growth 55%, margins 33.5%->39%, WACC 11.0%, TG 3.5%.
